title: goldenset-lineage-access-and-config-change-eval-hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We currently lack a reliable, auditable linkage between golden prompt/benchmark snapshots and config/model change events. This causes noisy or late detection of quality regressions after runtime or routing config changes, rollout of new quantized variants, or model pin updates. Goal: Implement a goldenset lineage and lightweight access model plus automated eval hooks that trigger targeted regression runs when relevant config or model changes are proposed or deployed. The solution should enable stewards to curate golden snapshots with provenance metadata, enforce steward/RBAC gates for editing, and attach immutable signatures to snapshots used for gating. It must integrate with our CI/rollout pipeline so that any config that could affect outputs (runtime flags, quantization profile, model variant, prompttransform rules) records the affected goldenset lineage and triggers a prioritized regression eval. Acceptance criteria: 1) Golden snapshot metadata stores: curator, curator-email, parent-snapshot-id, creation-reason, guarding-config-tags, signature-hash, and stable version id. 2) UI/CLI for registering new golden snapshots with RBAC checks and optional cross-reference to PR/Confluence artifact. 3) A config-change hook that accepts a change descriptor and returns an ordered list of golden snapshots to run regressions against (based on guarding-config-tags and lineage). 4) Automated eval run orchestration that can be invoked by the rollout pipeline; returns pass/fail with deltas and links to diffed outputs. 5) Permissioned audit logs for who created/approved golden snapshots and who acknowledged regression failures. Non-goals: full ML metadata store replacement, migration of historical goldens beyond minimal backwards-compatibility mapping.
comments: 2025-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after post-mortem where a Dedicated quantization rollout caused a 9% ROUGE drop for a customer. Root cause: rollout targeted model variant without running the right promptset. Proposed lineage tagging to avoid recurrence.

2025-03-03 - Miguel Ortega: Initial design spike complete. Decided to attach two new fields to golden metadata: guarding-config-tags (list of strings) and parent_snapshot pointer (stable id). Implemented storage as immutable snapshots in S3 with a small metadata JSON index in our metadata-service.

2025-03-04 - Design review (Lena Brooks): Suggested adding curator_email to metadata and a minimal UI flow for 'register golden snapshot' to reduce friction for stewards. Also recommended signer workflow for immutability (GPG/HSM sig).

2025-03-05 - PM sync (Tom Hsu): PM asked for prioritization logic: prefer direct descendants, then snapshots that list overlapping guarding-config-tags, then global regression baseline. We'll implement scoring to order eval runs to minimize cost.

2025-03-06 - Miguel Ortega: Prototype of config-change hook posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1128. Hook accepts a change manifest (JSON) and returns candidate snapshot ids. Still WIP: scoring and blacklisting of very large goldens.
2025-03-07 - Security review request submitted: Confluence -> https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/EVALS/Golden+Lineage+Security. Awaiting SRE feedback on signer integration with KMS.

2025-03-08 - QA note (Priya Mehta): Need deterministic ordering for eval gating to avoid flaky falls through canary runs. Also ask that the eval runner preserves prompt seed and deterministic RNG where applicable.

2025-03-09 - Engineering decision: Use an append-only golden index with SHA256 signature field and signer metadata. RBAC enforced in metadata-service with "steward" role. Backend implementation will add a fast lookup table mapping guarding-config-tags -> snapshot ids for quick hook responses.

2025-03-10 - Next steps (Miguel Ortega): 1) Finish scoring algorithm and implement tag->snapshot index; 2) Wire hook into rollout pipeline (runtime-rollouts service) so CI can request targeted evals; 3) Add UI flow for registering and viewing snapshot lineage; 4) Add automated alerts to Console when regression > configured threshold. Assigned follow-ups to ENG-24712 (indexing work) and DES-4523 (UI mockups).
